title: GST 113 ( UNIZK ) : HUMAN RELATIONS FOR SELF AND ORGANIZATIONAL DEVELOPMENT
subject: GST 113

questions.question: Man is described as which type of being?
questions.explanation: Man is a social being who depends on others for full survival.

questions.question: Obiefuna holds that humans rationally relate through which statement?
questions.explanation: Obiefuna states that to live is to interact rationally.

questions.question: Career Guide defines human relations as the ability to interact in which manner?
questions.explanation: Career Guide sees human relations as interacting in a healthy manner.

questions.question: Lamberton and Minor-Evans define human relations as working effectively through which group?
questions.explanation: Human relations is the ability to work effectively through and with other people.

questions.question: Which type of human relation involves student-student relations?
questions.explanation: Interpersonal relations involve interactions among individuals.

questions.question: Inter-group relations involve interactions between which entities?
questions.explanation: Inter-group relations occur when two or more groups interact.

questions.question: Interactions among members of a particular group are known as which relation?
questions.explanation: Intra-group relations involve interactions among members of a particular group.

questions.question: Which form of human relation involves a disagreement over a particular issue?
questions.explanation: Conflict involves disagreement over a particular issue.

questions.question: Which form of human relation is based on the idea of give and take?
questions.explanation: Exchange is based on the idea of give and take.

questions.question: Working together as a team in a symbiotic manner to achieve a goal describes which form?
questions.explanation: Cooperation involves working together in a symbiotic manner.

questions.question: Teams playing a football match demonstrate which form of human relation?
questions.explanation: Competition involves trying to take the upper hand over another.

questions.question: Akpuru-Aja defines conflict as a continuing reality of which concept?
questions.explanation: Akpuru-Aja sees conflict as a continuing reality of human existence.

questions.question: Ken describes conflict management as the operationalisation of which items?
questions.explanation: Conflict management operationalises strategic provisions of resolution agendas.

questions.question: Checking individual attachments so they do not affect organizational goals is part of which skill?
questions.explanation: Management of relationships ensures attachments do not mar organizational goals.

questions.question: Working together towards the realization of organizational goals describes which skill?
questions.explanation: Teamwork skill involves members working together towards goals.

questions.question: The process of choosing among alternatives is known as which skill?
questions.explanation: Decision making is the process of choosing among alternatives.

questions.question: Obiefuna holds that which element remains the hallmark of human relations?
questions.explanation: Obiefuna states communication remains the hallmark of human relations.

questions.question: Gunthner sees communication as which type of skill for human relations?
questions.explanation: Gunthner views communication as the fundamental skill upon which others are built.

questions.question: Understanding the feelings or challenges others are passing through is known as which skill?
questions.explanation: Empathy is the skill that allows one to understand others' feelings.

questions.question: Empathy goes beyond pity to doing which action for the individual?
questions.explanation: Empathy involves trying to help out the individual in bearing the burden.

questions.question: The ability to manage opposing views without causing damage to the system is known as which skill?
questions.explanation: Negotiation skill manages opposing views without causing system damage.

questions.question: Being aware of and managing one's emotions and the emotions of others describes which skill?
questions.explanation: Emotional intelligence involves being aware of and managing emotions.

questions.question: Which skill requires handling cultural diversity in a workplace with respect?
questions.explanation: Cultural competence involves handling cultural diversity with respect.

questions.question: Listening carefully to others without prejudices or biases describes which skill?
questions.explanation: Listening skill allows objective understanding without prejudices or biases.

questions.question: Cherry states that self-esteem is similar to which concept?
questions.explanation: Cherry states self-esteem is similar to self-respect.

questions.question: People with high self-esteem are generally good in which types of relations?
questions.explanation: People with strong self-esteem are good in intra and interpersonal relations.

questions.question: Individuals with low self-esteem often focus heavily on which aspect of themselves?
questions.explanation: People with low self-esteem usually focus on their weaknesses.

questions.question: Which philosopher is attributed with the words man knows thyself?
questions.explanation: The words man knows thyself are attributed to Socrates.

questions.question: Oraegbunam affirms that differences exist among individuals in intelligence, temper, and which other area?
questions.explanation: Individual differences include variations in intelligence, temper, and attitude.

questions.question: Revealing oneself to others after achieving self-awareness is known as which concept?
questions.explanation: Self-disclosure comes when self-awareness is achieved.

questions.question: Okonkwo defines motivation as a psycho-physiological or which other type of process?
questions.explanation: Motivation is defined as a psycho-physiological or internal process.

questions.question: Motivation that comes from outside the individual is described as which type?
questions.explanation: Extrinsic motivation comes from outside the individual.

questions.question: Obiefuna holds that motivation is like which internal element?
questions.explanation: Obiefuna holds that motivation is like internal fire.

questions.question: Career Guide sees attitude as favorable or unfavorable opinions toward people, things, or which other aspect?
questions.explanation: Attitude includes opinions toward people, things, or situations.

questions.question: Negative attitudes in a workplace are described as having which effect on human relations?
questions.explanation: Negative attitudes are described as cancerous in human relations.

questions.question: Appreciating diversity in a human organization makes it possible to experience which type of relations?
questions.explanation: Understanding and appreciating diversity makes good human relations possible.

questions.question: Having mutual regards and considerations among individuals in an organization describes which promotion method?
questions.explanation: Mutual respect implies mutual regards and considerations among parties.

questions.question: A formal discussion between two parties over an issue that affects them is known as which method?
questions.explanation: Dialogue is a formal discussion between two or more parties.

questions.question: Dialogue removes the tendency of which anti-human relations concept?
questions.explanation: Dialogue removes the tendency of hegemonism.

questions.question: Ensuring the culture of transparency and integrity helps to remove which negative feeling in relationships?
questions.explanation: Transparency and integrity remove suspicion in relationships.

questions.question: The quality of listening to other people's views and being ready to compromise is known as which virtue?
questions.explanation: Tolerance is listening to others' views and being ready to compromise.

questions.question: Giving each person what is his or her due is the definition of which concept?
questions.explanation: Justice is the quality of giving each what is his or her due.

questions.question: Being ready to give feedback to those around goes a long way in shaping which aspect of an organization?
questions.explanation: Feedback shapes human relations in an organization.

questions.question: The statement man knows thyself; then thou shalt know the universe and God is attributed to which figure?
questions.explanation: Pythagoras stated man knows thyself; then thou shalt know the universe and God.

questions.question: Obiefuna states that people with strong self-esteem are open to which activity?
questions.explanation: People with strong self-esteem are open to discussions.

questions.question: Individuals with positive self-esteem avoid dwelling on which type of experiences?
questions.explanation: Positive self-esteem avoids dwelling on past negative experiences.

questions.question: The expected benefit of a worker's salary at the end of the month is considered which factor?
questions.explanation: Expected benefits like salary act as motivation.

questions.question: A receptionist with a cheerful and upbeat attitude will result in which outcome for the office?
questions.explanation: A cheerful attitude results in positive human relations.

questions.question: Which concept notes that differences are not just physical variations but also variations in intelligence and aptitude?
questions.explanation: Individual differences include variations in intelligence and aptitude.

questions.question: According to Socrates, knowing oneself is the beginning of which concept?
questions.explanation: Socrates states that to know oneself is the beginning of wisdom.
